title: Lightweight Toxicity Detection in Spoken Language: A Transformer-based Approach for Edge Devices
reasoning: The paper focuses on the engineering and optimization of a speech-based toxicity detection model (using wav2vec2.0) for deployment on edge devices. It evaluates performance metrics like F1-score and accuracy on speech datasets but does not include a component focused on evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems.
